> **Beta of this fork** of [iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy](https://github.com/iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy), built on upstream **2.0.6** ([its release notes](https://github.com/iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy/releases/tag/v2.0.6)). Samsung packages: Tizen 6.5–7 (`NuvioTpk65`) and Tizen 8–9 (`NuvioTpk`). It is a pre-release, so installed apps do not auto-update to it: install the `.tpk` by hand (Apps2Samsung).

## From upstream 2.0.6
- **DTS / TrueHD / AC3 on Samsung**: converted to Dolby Digital on the TV, no more silent sources.
- **PGS (Blu-ray) subtitles** drawn in the player.
- **Optional top bar** instead of the side rail; **CH+ / CH−** in every hint.
- **New row styles**: Hero, Round (people) and Large poster.
- **Player**: Previous, Next and Reload buttons; skip credits; subtitle outline colour and track names.
- **Sources**: cache state on debrid sources and a stricter "Cached" filter.
- Collections, director filmographies, profiles fully isolated and many fixes: see the upstream notes.

## This fork, on top of 2.0.6
- Audio and subtitle **flags** on every source, and the **Dubbed** filter (Spanish → English).
- **Latin American Spanish** and **Portuguese (BR)** audio/subtitle languages, next to their family. A setting saved by 2.0.5-b2 is carried over.
- **Logos on landscape cards**, portrait art for Top 10 / ranking rows, "Portrait poster" always portrait, smooth expand/close of focused cards.
- The "No sound" warning for DTS/TrueHD now only shows when the TV cannot convert them.
